name: CLI installation and ABI
evidence: Final release installation and native DP/QP, pole/cache smoke pass. A later configuration-failure rollback fix passes 66 installer/control tests without changing native artifacts.

name: Generated Fortran integration
evidence: 17 final-release forced-mode runs cover external, relocated internal and NLO outputs; maximum symmetric error 1.29e-15. Forced modes do not establish stability acceptance.

name: QP transport and cache isolation
evidence: Nine native bridge tests include binary128 last-bit transport, 256/384-bit convergence, failed-cache cleanup, bounded QP caching and rank-six mapping. Debug builds; no runtime claim.

name: Accelerated poles-only path
evidence: N=1–6, rank six, UV/IR/scaleless and rescue/cache checks pass; finite evaluators and arithmetic are absent. 288 scalar comparisons and byte-identical regeneration pass.

name: Native library coexistence
evidence: Both link orders and both initialization orders pass with unchanged NinjaRS dependency revisions. Earlier concurrent-license failure retained; qualification runs are serialized.

name: Generated pole diagnostics
evidence: 96 served full/partial DP/QP pairs agree; 12 DP pairs refuse both modes and all 54 QP pairs pass. Partial finite outputs are NaN. Explicit refusals are retained and are not successful accelerated evaluations.

name: Generated cache lifecycle
evidence: 59 native records cover DP/QP references, hits, independent checks, modes, topology limits, byte budgets, clear/finalize and reinitialization. Stored and uncached tensors agree at the recorded precision.

name: Fortran prefix optimization
evidence: 481,536 bit/IEEE checks pass at each optimization level. Kernel timing improves; stubbed-wrapper gains vary. Physical-amplitude acceptance is separate.

name: Default stability stress case
evidence: Default 1e-3 native checks miss one correlated rank-five DP error. At 1e-6 the production rescue block with actual tensor callbacks switches to QP and resolves it; complete physical initialization is outside this isolated check.

name: Complex-mass stress campaign
evidence: All five reducers pass 19 moderate points; ordinary TIRust differences are at most 5.96e-13. Two extreme forward points fail in several reducers; forced-QP adjudication remains open.

name: Full five-backend acceptance
evidence: The main matrix above records the independent physical and paired runtime gates. Completed interface checks do not substitute for those measurements.
